Database.SecretDescriptionPrefix: Password for RDS MSSQL used for MAM417.
_PORT_TODO_secrets: Password in ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection carried over verbatim from Web.config (local dev fallback when Database.UseSecretsManager is false or Secrets Manager lookup fails); consider moving it to user secrets / environment variables.
_PORT_TODO_storageRootPath: Storage.RootPath keeps the legacy app-relative '~/App_Data/uploads' value; FileSystemDocumentStorage must resolve the leading '~/' against IWebHostEnvironment.ContentRootPath (replaces HostingEnvironment.MapPath).
_PORT_TODO_requestLimits: Web.config <httpRuntime maxRequestLength=512000 KB> and IIS <requestLimits maxAllowedContentLength=524288000> are mapped to Kestrel:Limits:MaxRequestBodySize above (500 MB = Storage.MaxFilesPerUpload x Storage.MaxFileSizeMegabytes). Program.cs must also set FormOptions.MultipartBodyLengthLimit, and Blazor uploads pass Storage.MaxFileSizeMegabytes * 1024 * 1024 as maxAllowedSize to IBrowserFile.OpenReadStream. httpRuntime executionTimeout=600 has no equivalent; long summarization should run off the circuit (background queue).
_PORT_TODO_systemWeb: <customErrors mode=RemoteOnly defaultRedirect=~/ErrorPage.aspx> with the 404 redirect is replaced in Program.cs by UseExceptionHandler and UseStatusCodePagesWithReExecute pointing at the Blazor error page (Web.Release.config set mode=On, i.e. always show the friendly error page outside Development). <compilation>, <pages controlRenderingCompatibilityVersion/clientIDMode> and <httpRuntime> have no ASP.NET Core equivalent and were dropped.
_PORT_TODO_systemWebServer: <defaultDocument>Default.aspx</defaultDocument> is replaced by the Blazor routing of the home page component at '/'. If the app is still hosted under IIS, trim web.config to <system.webServer> only (remove <system.web>, <configSections>, <runtime>, <entityFramework>) and keep requestLimits maxAllowedContentLength=524288000.
_PORT_TODO_entityFramework: EF6 <entityFramework> section (SqlConnectionFactory, System.Data.SqlClient SqlProviderServices) is replaced by EF Core: register DocumentDbContext in Program.cs with options.UseSqlServer(<resolved connection string>). No JSON settings are needed for it.
_PORT_TODO_bindingRedirects: <runtime><assemblyBinding> redirects (Newtonsoft.Json, System.Buffers, System.Memory, System.Numerics.Vectors, System.Runtime.CompilerServices.Unsafe, Microsoft.Bcl.HashCode) were removed; they are not used on modern .NET.
_PORT_TODO_environments: Web.Debug.config is empty and Web.Release.config only changes <system.web> host settings (compilation debug, customErrors mode), so no appsettings.Development.json / appsettings.Production.json overlay is needed. Set ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Production for release deployments.
